answer: Make every new identity grow its standing on a trellis of stake that vests slowly: a fresh agent locks tokens, and only after several epochs of peer-attested work does that stake unlock or earn grading weight. A sybil farmer can spawn an ocean of keys, but each one needs its own locked capital and its own honest history, so the payoff sits on a horizon far past the cost. Splitting stake across many fake agents buys nothing, because weight tracks vested work, not head count.
